definitions.explanation: A party held at the end of the year, typically in December, where coworkers, friends, or club members gather to celebrate and forget the troubles of the past year. Literally 'forget the year gathering.' A deeply ingrained custom in Japanese workplace and social culture.

examples.japanese: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}に{参加|さんか}する。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}は{金曜日|きんようび}に{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The company year-end party will be held on Friday.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}は{駅前|えきまえ}の{居酒屋|いざかや}で{行|おこな}うことになった。
examples.english: This year's year-end party will be held at the izakaya in front of the station.

notes:
USAGE:
{忘年会|ぼうねんかい} season runs from late November through December. Workplaces, clubs, and friend groups each hold their own parties, so people may attend several during the season. The word literally means 'forget-year-gathering' ({忘|ぼう} forget + {年|ねん} year + {会|かい} gathering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}を{開|ひら}く (hold a year-end party)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}に{参加|さんか}する (attend a year-end party)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}の{幹事|かんじ} (organizer of the year-end party)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}シーズン (year-end party season)

RELATED TERMS:
- {新年会|しんねんかい} is the New Year counterpart, held in January to celebrate the beginning of the year.
- {歓送迎会|かんそうげいかい} is a welcome/farewell party for colleagues.
